integrity: The claimed asymptotic is deduced from exact renewal thinning, Gaussian saddle estimates and a finite Laplace exponential moment; deterministic finite checks are not a proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite N, 2 <= m < N, one-dimensional Brownian diffusion, independent uniformly marked Poisson resets. Not uniform at m=1 or m=N; not a growing-N extreme limit. Existing exact pair-density formula implicitly determines the claimed tail, and independent novelty assessment remains outstanding.
title: Sharp pair-exceedance prefactor and singular tail dependence under batch resetting
